capabilities.label: Git-resident Academy course corpus
capabilities.notes: Thirty-two lesson bundles exist, but the legacy manifest covers only part of the corpus and no course is certified by Harness V2.

capabilities.label: Public Academy catalog
capabilities.notes: The catalog is learner-visible and database-backed, but its fallback and design catalog previously used separate authorities.

capabilities.label: Learner lesson player
capabilities.notes: A learner-visible lesson route and player exist; individual course publication and content certification remain separate concerns.

capabilities.label: Interactive lab runtime
capabilities.notes: Learner-visible runtimes exist, but current output-substring verification is not trusted for mastery or certification until Step 4A.

capabilities.label: FSRS spaced review and repair
capabilities.notes: Scheduling, review UI, and actions exist; the complete delayed-recall enforcement journey still requires Step 7 proof.

capabilities.label: Learner mastery map
capabilities.notes: Mastery logic and a profile component exist, while the current lesson surface explicitly documents incomplete guide/map integration.

capabilities.label: Lesson-grounded AI tutor
capabilities.notes: API and UI code exist; live-key availability, grounding, injection resistance, and dependency-reducing behavior remain production gates.

capabilities.label: Learner progress and evidence ledger
capabilities.notes: Progress and evidence code exists, but evidence trust and immutable release attribution are not complete.

capabilities.label: Certificate rendering and verification
capabilities.notes: Certificate surfaces exist; immutable releases, revocation proof, and certification governance are planned work.

capabilities.label: Academy checkout and entitlement lifecycle
capabilities.notes: Checkout code exists, but canonical packaging, live Stripe objects, and full lifecycle proof require operator decisions and explicit approval.

capabilities.label: Authoritative Academy certification harness
capabilities.notes: One offline command audits all canonical courses and fails closed on pending evidence and untrusted labs. Full rendered, expert, human, source-governance, and controlled-lab evidence remains incomplete, so no course is certified.

capabilities.label: Immutable course and lesson releases
capabilities.notes: Current rows are mutable draft/published records; versioned release snapshots are required before paid beta.
